in_sanskrit.name: Kaku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little one
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kaku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kaka', meaning 'male crow' or 'little one'. In Hindu mythology, Kakas are considered auspicious and are associated with Lord Krishna.

in_tamil.name: Kaku
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Little one
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kaku ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kaka', meaning 'male crow' or 'little one'. In Hindu mythology, Kakas are considered auspicious and are associated with Lord Krishna.

in_telugu.name: Kaku
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kaku ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kaka', meaning 'male crow' or 'little one'. In Hindu mythology, Kakas are considered auspicious and are associated with Lord Krishna.

in_marathi.name: Kaku
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kaka', meaning 'male crow' or 'little one'. In Hindu mythology, Kakas are considered auspicious and are associated with Lord Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Kaku
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little one
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kaku একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'kaka', meaning 'male crow' or 'little one'. In Hindu mythology, Kakas are considered auspicious and are associated with Lord Krishna.
